absences: Dockets (Type F): no state PUC, legislature or IRP filing naming microreactors or SMRs dated 2026-08-05 to 2026-11-03 was found. Dominion PUR-2025-00196 (Rider SMR) was filed in 2025 and is not microreactor-specific. NY RFQ (May 2026) and Maine PUC RFP (statutory, unconfirmed) do not qualify. No dockets written.

Items (Type N): no dated policy or regulatory event after 2026-10-30 was found in indexed sources. NDAA FY2027 nuclear text, NRC Commission votes in November, and DOE FY2027 appropriations status were searched and not found after Oct 30. No items written.
Part 57 final-rule deadline of 2026-11-23 (from the executive order) was seen only in a search summary, not in a fetched primary page. Not used in any record.
Texas HB 14 expansion toward $2B: not stated in the NRC-linked fetched pages (governor statement, ANS 2026-04-09). Texas fund recipients (TANEO said July 2026 announcement) not found.
Deployable Energy Unity criticality date: shipped June 30; ANS 2026-07-02 gives a July 1 announcement only. Left unchanged, not checked against DOE or INL primary.
Alaska regulations year: WNN 2023-07-28 says regulations come into effect in August; the year 2023 is inferred from that dateline.

Primary sources not fetched: Federal Register for Part 57 proposed rule, NRC rulemaking schedule, DOE pilot program page. WebFetch of federalregister.gov redirected to an unblock page; govinfo used instead.

checks.claim: NRC's own estimate is $3.76–11.84B in combined savings and licensing-to-deployment in 6–12 months for qualifying designs.
checks.evidence: ANS, 2026-04-27: NRC says Part 57 will save 'anywhere from $3.76 billion to $11.84 billion' and projects licensing and deployment in 6–12 months. ANS, 2026-10-22: Part 57 'has yet to be finalized', so the proposed-rule status still holds at that date.
